name: bobi-english-adventure
description: 波波熱血英語大冒險 & 茄苳國小四上總複習 (v2.5.0) - 1,080 關英語 + 桃園八德茄苳國小四年級五科第二次評量複習架構

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const v=pkg.version; global.window={}; require('./curriculum.js'); const d=window.CURRICULUM_DATA; const totalLessons=d.reduce((s,t)=>s+t.lessons.length,0); const html=fs.readFileSync('./index.html','utf8'); const g4html=fs.readFileSync('./grade4.html','utf8'); const g4=require('./curriculum_g4_jdes.js'); const readme=fs.readFileSync('./README.md','utf8'); const changelog=fs.readFileSync('./CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); if(window.BOBI_VERSION!==v||window.CURRICULUM_VERSION!==v) throw new Error('Version mismatch in curriculum.js'); if(!html.includes('content=\"'+v+'\"')||!html.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in index.html'); if(!g4html.includes('content=\"'+v+'\"')||!g4html.includes('v'+v)||g4.meta.version!==v) throw new Error('Version mismatch in grade4.html or curriculum_g4_jdes.js'); if(!readme.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in README.md'); if(!changelog.includes('['+v+']')) throw new Error('Version mismatch in CHANGELOG.md'); if(d.length!==12||totalLessons!==1080) throw new Error('Curriculum count mismatch: expected 12 tiers & 1080 lessons, got '+d.length+' tiers & '+totalLessons+' lessons'); const sReg=/<script(?![^>]*src=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi; let m; while((m=sReg.exec(html))!==null){ new Function(m[1]); } while((m=sReg.exec(g4html))!==null){ new Function(m[1]); } d.forEach(t=>t.lessons.forEach(l=>l.questions.forEach(q=>{ if(q.options){ const zhSet=new Set(q.options.map(o=>o.zh||o.text)); if(q.options.length!==4||zhSet.size!==4||q.options.filter(o=>o.correct).length!==1) throw new Error('Invalid options in '+l.id); } }))); if(g4.subjects.length!==5) throw new Error('Expected 5 subjects in curriculum_g4_jdes.js'); let g4QCount=0; g4.subjects.forEach(s=>s.units.forEach(u=>{ if(!u.keyConcepts||!u.keyConcepts.length) throw new Error('Missing keyConcepts in '+u.id); (u.questions||[]).forEach(q=>{ g4QCount++; if(!q.options||q.options.length<2||q.correctIndex<0||q.correctIndex>=q.options.length) throw new Error('Invalid G4 question '+q.id); }); })); console.log('✅ [5-Way Version Alignment Verified] v'+v+' across package.json, curriculum.js, index.html, grade4.html, curriculum_g4_jdes.js, README.md, CHANGELOG.md'); console.log('✅ [Frontend Syntax & Logic Verified] index.html & grade4.html inline scripts compiled cleanly!'); console.log('✅ [Curriculum Verified] English: '+d.length+' tiers & '+totalLessons+' levels | JDES G4: '+g4.subjects.length+' subjects & '+g4QCount+' exam prep questions!');"
